fails_if: concept-group-candidates reads accepted scopes from anywhere but `--curation-dir` (say the checkout's tree), or stops re-including the members of a group the named tree declares as a literal `[[group]]`, so an accepted family is dropped from its own regeneration; or re-includes an accepted group's member in a family keyed other than that group; or keeps a member whose only group the named tree does not declare
note: The overlay adds a literal `[[group]] morsak` over morsak1-3, so the build materializes the family as a curated group. Run 1 names the tree that built the artifact: both of its groups (`dodsorsak-forsta`, `morsak`) are accepted scopes, so morsak1-3 re-emit under their own key, while dodsorsak1, claimed by `dodsorsak-forsta` whose key is not its stem `dodsorsak`, stays out of dodsorsak2-3. Run 2 names `silent`, the same tree with its register file's `[[group]]`s removed: every member of a materialized group is excluded, so morsak forms no family (and so counts no key collision) and dodsorsak is 2-3. The counts are the families case's less morsak.
